summary: Set [[Prototype]] with RequireObjectCoercible, prototype validation, cycle/invariant checks, and Proxy behavior.

semantics.proto: must be Object or null, otherwise TypeError
semantics.primitive_target: after proto validation, non-object target is returned unchanged

caveats: Order matters: Object.setPrototypeOf(1, 2) throws for invalid proto even though target is primitive.
C# inheritance cannot model mutable per-object prototypes.

tests.name: invalid proto checked for primitive target
